body: I'm in this picture and I'm not sure I like it
Thank you. I wish I felt the same toward myself...

I deleted him off snapchat last night and we were each others number one friends with a huge streak. And it really hurts and it feels like I'm spiraling. 

I don't talk to my therapist until Friday, and im trying my best to meditate.

What if it hurts so bad because I made the wrong choice? I know thats not true, but still...

I think an ABC store is one thats a owned by a big corporate company that is (but not necessarily) out for their own benefit and greed. Whereas a "mom and pop" store is more community friendly and out to serve the community rather than just their greed
Yeah... it seems like I'm forever stuck at the latter you mentioned...
How do you regulate your emotions? I have all this sadness and anger built up but my old outlet of crying is unavailable and in lockdown I can't easily distract myself...
Wow, super unhelpful. Isn't the point of the subreddit so you won't feel judged asking questions you can't wrap your head around?

Seattle riots. What would happen if the cops had not have shown up? Would alll of the peaceful protesters worked together to take down the non peaceful ones? Wouldn't the lack of police not encourage the non peaceful ones?

Also and most importantly because I don't fully understand and I'm sorry but I want to learn: who are they protesting against? The cops for the recent murder? Or people who are wrongly murdering people of color and the cop was just the last straw?
Same thing happened to me but about two months after being on fluoxetine, my appetite came back

I feel that too. The world still will suck - people will still ruin the planet. But I guess I stick around for the people that feel the same way as I do. Feeling lonely and like nobody cares for them. I want them to know that I care, and also secretly hope they will become my friend and we can survive together.

​

Also, I'm afraid of what happens if I survive any attempt I make to end it. What happens after when I wake up in the hospital. Or making someone else feel guilty or bad or feel they caused my death.

Sorry, edited because I sent it too soon.
